name: week
title: Contract week
subtitle: Fictional demo until you import your records

sections.title: Renewal decisions
sections.sql: select reference,name,owner,action_on,days_left,decision,overdue_obligations,due_reminders from renewal_queue order by action_on nulls first

sections.title: Obligations
sections.sql: select contract,title,owner,due_on,contract_status from obligation_queue order by due_on

sections.title: Reminders
sections.sql: select contract,title,owner,due_on from reminder_queue order by due_on

sections.title: Evidence and record checks
sections.sql: select reference,rule,finding from compliance_findings order by reference,rule

sections.title: Personal information and holds
sections.sql: select reference,jurisdiction,retention_review_on,retention_basis,legal_hold from contracts where contains_personal order by retention_review_on nulls first
